title: How to Cancel NordVPN — Step-by-Step Guide (2026)
metaDescription: Cancel NordVPN subscription and get a refund within 30 days. Stop auto-renewal and avoid being charged again. Complete guide with refund steps.
intro: NordVPN has a 30-day money-back guarantee, so if you're within that window you can get a full refund. Even after 30 days, you can stop auto-renewal so you won't be charged again when your plan expires.

steps.title: Log in to your Nord Account
steps.text: Go to my.nordaccount.com and sign in with your NordVPN credentials. Click on "Services" or navigate to the NordVPN section.

steps.title: Go to Subscription settings
steps.text: Find your NordVPN subscription and click "Change plan" or navigate to the billing/subscription section. Look for "Auto-renewal" settings.

steps.title: Turn off auto-renewal
steps.text: Click "Cancel automatic payments" or toggle off auto-renewal. This prevents future charges. Your VPN access continues until your current plan expires.
steps.tip: If you're within 30 days of purchase, skip this step and go straight to support for a full refund instead.

steps.title: Request a refund (if within 30 days)
steps.text: If you're within the 30-day money-back period: click the chat bubble for live support, tell them you want to cancel and request a refund. They'll process it within 5-10 business days.
steps.tip: Be direct: 'I'd like to cancel my subscription and request a refund under the 30-day guarantee.' Don't explain too much — they're required to honor it.

steps.title: Confirm cancellation via email
steps.text: Check your email for a cancellation/refund confirmation from NordVPN. If paying via PayPal, the refund appears in 5-10 days. Credit card refunds take 5-10 business days.

warnings: If you purchased through Apple App Store or Google Play, you must cancel through their subscription settings and request refund through them.
After the 30-day window, you cannot get a refund — but you can stop auto-renewal so you keep access until expiry without being re-charged.
NordVPN often sells 1-year or 2-year plans. Turning off auto-renewal means you keep the full remaining time but won't be charged again.
Third-party purchases (StackSocial, etc.) have different refund policies — contact that vendor instead.

faqs.q: Can I get a refund from NordVPN?
faqs.a: Yes, within 30 days of purchase under their money-back guarantee. Contact live chat support and request a refund. After 30 days, no refund is available but you can cancel auto-renewal.

faqs.q: How long does a NordVPN refund take?
faqs.a: Refunds are processed within 5-10 business days. PayPal refunds may be faster (2-3 days). Credit card refunds depend on your bank.

faqs.q: Will my NordVPN account be deleted when I cancel?
faqs.a: No. Your account remains active but without VPN access after your plan expires. You can reactivate anytime by purchasing a new plan.

faqs.q: What's a good free alternative to NordVPN?
faqs.a: ProtonVPN offers a free tier with unlimited data (3 server locations). Windscribe offers 10GB/month free. Built-in browser VPNs (Opera) work for basic browsing privacy.

refund.details: NordVPN offers a full 30-day money-back guarantee with no questions asked. Contact live chat support to request it. After 30 days, no refund is available but you keep access through your plan expiration.

retentionTactics: Live chat agents may offer an extended subscription at a discount.
They may suggest pausing your account or switching to a cheaper plan.
They'll ask why you're leaving and try to address your concern before processing cancellation.
